forum.title: STM32F072CBT6TR moisture sensitivity (MSL) - 2 or 3 ?
forum.best_answer_content:
The MSL is typically found in the Materials Declaration, which can be viewed on the respective product website under the tab [**Quality and Reliability**](https://www.st.com/en/microcontrollers-microprocessors/stm32f072cb.html#quality-reliability). In the case of the STM32F072CBT6TR, MSL 2 is specified there. However, for various reasons, the packaging delivered to you may indicate a different MSL, whether due to a different backend or repackaged devices at the distributor. Therefore, the statement on the packaging label is always decisive.

Does it answer your question?

Regards

/Peter
forum.content_text: Hi, What is the official moisture sensitivity level (MSL) for STM32F072CBT6TR? I found conflicting information showing both MSL 2 and MSL 3.
